units: per share; theta per calendar day, vega per 1 vol point, rho per 1 rate point

price.why: CDF error through S + K <= 220 on this grid is at most 3.3e-5; measured 1.5e-5

delta.why: N(d1) itself: CDF error at most 1.5e-7; measured 6.9e-8

gamma.why: no CDF term, float rounding only; measured 2.8e-17

theta.why: CDF error scaled by r*K*e^-rT/365 <= 1.4e-2 is at most 2.1e-9; measured 9.5e-10

vega.why: no CDF term, float rounding only; measured 1.1e-16

rho.why: CDF error scaled by K*T*e^-rT/100 <= 1 is at most 1.5e-7; measured 6.7e-8

strategy_expiry_payoff.why: prices and premiums carry at most 4 dp, so the canonical's 4 dp rounding removes nothing; measured 2.7e-15

strategy_pnl.why: one 4 dp step: 5e-5 is the canonical's rounding, the rest the browser's CDF; measured 5.4e-5

strategy_delta.why: 6 dp rounding (5e-7) plus CDF error 1.5e-7 over the widest case's 8 contract-legs; measured 8.4e-7

strategy_gamma.why: one 6 dp step, the canonical's rounding; measured 5.0e-7

strategy_theta.why: one 6 dp step, the canonical's rounding; measured 4.7e-7

strategy_vega.why: one 6 dp step, the canonical's rounding; measured 4.9e-7
